units.source_text: 当初我以为在荒僻的山乡地方决不会出这种乱子，

en.t: At first I thought that in such a remote mountain village this kind of trouble could never happen,

units.source_text: 真是幼稚之见！

en.t: What a childish idea that was!

units.source_text: 论理，这女子倘是与我漠不相关的，

en.t: Reasonably speaking, if this woman had nothing at all to do with me,

units.source_text: 你要爱她尽听尊便。

en.t: you would be perfectly free to love her as you pleased.

units.source_text: 可是我和你从小莫逆相亲，

en.t: But you and I have been intimate friends since childhood,

units.source_text: 我曾经千方百计地为你拉线，替你带路，

en.t: and I once did everything I could to make connections for you and show you the way,

units.source_text: 你对我难道可以做这等亏心负义之事？

en.t: so how could you do something so heartless and ungrateful to me?

units.source_text: 思想起来，实甚痛心！

en.t: When I think of it, it truly pains me!

units.source_text: 我对你那二女公子，虽亦倾心恋慕，

en.t: Though I too was deeply in love with that second young lady of yours,

units.source_text: 然而多年以来，关系清清白白，

en.t: for all these many years our relationship remained completely innocent,

units.source_text: 足见我心何等稳重。

en.t: which shows how restrained my heart has been.

units.source_text: 况且我对二女公子，

en.t: Besides, as for my feelings toward the second young lady,

units.source_text: 不是现今开始的不成体统的恋爱，

en.t: they were not some improper love that began only now,

units.source_text: 而是本来早就相识的。

en.t: but grew from a bond formed long ago.

units.source_text: 只因我有顾虑：

en.t: It was only because I had my concerns:

units.source_text: 如果存心不良，为人为己都很痛苦，

en.t: if one harbored improper intentions, it would bring great pain both to others and to oneself,

units.source_text: 所以严守尺度。

en.t: and so I kept strict bounds.

units.source_text: 现在想来，实在太迂阔了。

en.t: Thinking of it now, I was far too stiff and impractical.

units.source_text: 最近匂亲王连日患病，

en.t: Recently Prince Niou has been ill for days on end,

units.source_text: 家中问病客多，异常纷乱，

en.t: and with so many visitors coming to ask after him, the household has been in great disorder,

units.source_text: 不知他怎么能够写信遥寄宇治的。

en.t: so I do not know how he managed to write and send letters all the way to Uji.

units.source_text: 也许已经开始往来了吧。

en.t: Perhaps he has already begun going back and forth.

units.source_text: 宇治这条路，对恋人说来实在太远了。

en.t: The road to Uji is truly too far for lovers.

units.source_text: 前些时我曾听说，

en.t: Some time ago I heard that

units.source_text: 有一天匂亲王失踪了，

en.t: one day Prince Niou disappeared,

units.source_text: 大家找寻他呢。

en.t: and everyone was searching for him.

units.source_text: 他原来是为了这种事而心烦意乱，

en.t: So he had been troubled and distracted over this very matter,

units.source_text: 并不是生什么病。

en.t: and was not really ill at all.

units.source_text: 回想从前他恋爱二女公子时，

en.t: Thinking back to when he was in love with the second young lady,

units.source_text: 为了不能到宇治去，

en.t: because he could not go to Uji,

units.source_text: 那忧愁苦闷之状叫人看了发慌呢。”

en.t: the sight of his sorrow and anguish was enough to make anyone uneasy."

units.source_text: 他如此历历回思，

en.t: As he recalled all this so vividly,

units.source_text: 恍悟前日浮舟愁眉不展，

en.t: he suddenly understood why Ukifune had looked so gloomy the other day,

units.source_text: 神情恍惚，

en.t: with a dazed, absent expression,

units.source_text: 原来道理在此！

en.t: so this was the reason after all!
